judge.label: Reviewer application
judge.description: Apply to review Geometry Dash levels and recommend suitable rating tiers.

questions.label: How old are you?
questions.guidance: We use age ranges to plan safeguarding, supervision, and appropriate responsibilities. Your exact birthday is not requested.

questions.label: What is your timezone?
questions.guidance: Your browser suggests a timezone automatically; correct it if necessary.

questions.label: How many levels can you realistically review per week?
questions.guidance: Choose a sustainable amount rather than an ideal maximum.

questions.label: Why do you want to be a reviewer?
Tell us about your experience reviewing levels or giving creator feedback
What separates useful level feedback from feedback that is merely negative?
Describe a time evidence or another perspective changed your opinion about a level
A creator strongly disagrees with your review. How would you respond?
What could GD Avenue improve to make reviews more useful and fair?
What works well in this level?
What most needs improvement?
Is the gameplay readable and fair? Explain your judgment
How consistent and effective are the visuals?
What type of rate would you recommend this level for? (Rate, feature...)
What evidence supports that recommendation?
Write the concise feedback you would send to the creator
Can you reliably meet the weekly capacity you selected and communicate when you cannot?
Is there any context or accommodation you want staff to consider?

mod.description: Apply to help moderate GD Avenue and support a safe, welcoming community.

questions.label: How old are you?
questions.guidance: We use age ranges to plan safeguarding, supervision, and appropriate responsibilities. Your exact birthday is not requested.

questions.label: What is your timezone?
questions.guidance: Your browser suggests a timezone automatically; correct it if necessary.

questions.label: How much time can you realistically dedicate to moderation each week?
Why do you want to be a mod?
Tell us about your experience moderating communities or resolving conflict
What is the difference between stopping disruption and punishing a user?
A member repeatedly harasses others and breaks several rules. What would you do, in order?
A friend asks you to ignore a rule violation. How do you handle it?
You disagree with a decision made by higher staff. What do you do?
You receive private or sensitive information during an incident. What are your immediate steps?
A heated argument is escalating in a public channel. What is your first action?
options: Pause the disruption and assess immediate safety
Ignore it until someone reports it
Move the argument elsewhere without documenting it

questions.label: Explain why you chose that first action and what you would do next

entries.message:
## Wanna partner?
DM an Owner/Admin if you meet these standards
 - Be a positive, active, and SFW community
 - Have a partnership or any other ping format to partner
 - Have more than 100 members (if not you won't get pinged here)
 - Be nice and friendly when asking :)

## Only use this channel if you have creator points!
> Use <@358598636436979713>'s `/profile` command if you have linked your account to the bot so we can give you the role.

> If you haven't linked your GD account to your Discord account, please use `/account link` in https://discord.com/channels/717003826288394271/717004813845659671 and follow the steps.
### If you react or send a random message here, you will be restricted from using this channel FOREVER
Remember to follow our [feedback format](https://discord.com/channels/717003826288394271/1457746418574950441) and to **NOT SKIP OTHERS**. Failure to do so will result in restrictions.

faq.title: FAQ
entries:
How do I request my level?
> Try to use https://discord.com/channels/717003826288394271/1464023199535857867/1465793845513031680, if it's closed it will let you know.

How do I partner with GD Avenue?
> DM an Mayor/Secretary if your server follows our requirements found in https://discord.com/channels/717003826288394271/731145959043498116.

How do weekly requests work?
> Being active during the week sums up your activity count, the most active members get DMed on Sunday to claim their request each week.

How do I contact Mods/Staff/Admins?
> Use 'Staff contact' to open a private ticket in my selection menu, though only use this if needed.

My level got send/rejected in level requests, what do I do now?
> If your level got rejected, try to take into account the feedback we give you. If it got accepted, we might contact you with more info, but know that your level might be on its way to mods!

Where do I post/search for collabs?
> Use https://discord.com/channels/717003826288394271/1104487618026143754 and follow our guidelines!

Where do I ask for feedback?
> Use https://discord.com/channels/717003826288394271/1480304268346130552 and follow our guidelines!

Do you send levels to mods?
> Yes, though we only send a certain amount of levels, which are determined by how many judges are available per request wave.

Are there any extra resources related to the server?
> Yeah! You can find our **level idea generator**, extended rules, and an about us section on [this web](https://gdavenue.netlify.app/).

level_requests._comment: Main level request wave system. Replace channel/role IDs with real server IDs before use.

level_validation._comment: Checks submitted level IDs through GDHistory, GDRate+, and the direct GD/Boomlings endpoint. GDHistory is positive-evidence-only: an unindexed level remains unknown and is never auto-rejected. GDBrowser remains optional because Cloudflare may block hosted bots.

background._comment: Background telemetry and scheduled tasks. Safe to disable completely.

daily_summary._comment: Optional daily summary embed. If channel_id is empty, falls back to general_logging_channel_id.

weekly_recap._comment: Optional weekly recap embed. If channel_id is empty, falls back to the daily summary channel.

status_rotation._comment: Optional rotating presence. Each entry is an object: {type,text}. Types: playing, watching, listening, competing.

server_icon_rotation._comment: Rotates the server icon from configured image URLs. mode is disabled, linear, or random.

database._comment: Persistent storage. Turso/libSQL is preferred when turso_url plus TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN are configured. Otherwise leave path blank to auto-detect /var/data/avenue-guard/bot.db when a Render Persistent Disk is mounted, or set AVENUE_GUARD_DB_PATH.

backups._comment: Posts zipped database backups to Discord so bot memory survives even if host storage is misconfigured.

release_updates._comment: Reviewed public Avenue Guard releases. A non-empty release.json manifest is proposed automatically after deployment; /bot release can also create a proposal. Only published releases appear in the public API and website.

impact._comment: Persistent CV/community impact reports. /bot impact posts Markdown, CSV, trend CSV, breakdown CSV, and JSON attachments here and stores a DB snapshot.

historical_audit._comment: Owner-only side-development audit. Disabled by default. No live prioritization. Enable explicitly, then use /requests historical_audit

priority_system._comment: PPS v1 applies only when a genuinely new wave is created. Existing state and submissions remain legacy after migration

send_type_emojis._comment: Upload assets/discord-emojis/*.png as application emojis with these names, then paste each emoji ID here

operations._comment: Durable worker supervision, health history, permission checks, monthly reporting, and retention
